pulls.author: tabjy
pulls.body_excerpt: This patch implements [JDK-8336759](https://bugs.openjdk.org/browse/JDK-8336759) that recognizes int counted loops with long limits. Currently, patterns like `for ( int i =...; i < long_limit; ...)` where int `i` is implicitly promoted to long (i.e., `(long) i < long_limit`) is not recognized as (int) counted loop. This patch speculatively and optimistically converts long limits to ints and deoptimize if the limit is outside int range, allowing more optimization opportunities.
